See the README for the config reference. In short: `eviction.max_bytes` (default 50 GiB, or the `CACHE_MAX_BYTES` env var) is the LRU bound, `eviction.max_age` (default off) is the optional TTL, `eviction.interval` (default 24h) is the sweep cadence, and setting both limits to 0 disables eviction - which the server warns about, because the cache then grows until the disk fills.
